fields: [pic=1]Are you ready for our book club?
Oh… Was I supposed to read something…?
[pic=4]I’ve always wanted to be a part of a book club though!
Ah! Maybe we can make one here!
[pic=3]But for now, let me tell you about this one!
[pic=2]Have you heard of a book called Lyllith the Dragonslayer?
[pic=2]It’s a spinoff from a larger series called Scales And Tails. It’s a bunch of books in a low fantasy world.
[pic=3]All the books intertwine and tell a huge epic story filled with adventure, mystery, love, and death! It’s amazing!
[pic=3]See the title is also a play-on-words! Lyllith the Dragon SLAYER? or Lyllith the Dragon’s <bounce>LAYER!</bounce>
[pic=5]Buuuut, she’s only been with one dragon so far… <pause>There’s a slew of other creatures for sure, so…
[pic=4]Maybe that’s just hinting at what’s to come.
[pic=2]So as you can guess, Lyllith is the main character…
Lyllith’s a wolf! She’s badass, justice-driven, and full of mom-energy!
She’s a sellsword and usually frequents taverns until she finds a job.
A Job… Or a partner for the night.
One particular night, she learns about a dragon that’s terrorizing a nearby town…
Now Lyllith has taken on dragons before. They can be a bit spicy, but nothing she can’t handle.
But no amount of gear could’ve prepared her for this dragon…
[pic=3]We were just passing by and got caught up in your story!
[pic=4]No no, it’s a book series I really like. I was just telling Rascal about it.
[pic=2]Oh that’s great! Again, don’t mind us, we’re just here to listen.
[pic=2]Do go on! I love hearing about how couples meet!
[pic=4]Ooooh! Yeah these two actually had some pretty rough beginnings!
[pic=4]The entire second book was about the random circumstances they would cross eachother’s paths, and butt heads.
[pic=2]Well…<pause> Rivals turned co-workers…<pause> Turned co-workers with benefits?
[pic=3]There was a nice little Winter scene that sums up how their dynamic is…
It was a quiet night. Fresh snow danced around the sky before landing on their cheeks and snouts.
Volkyn (that’s the dragon) gives the wolf a pathetic look.
"Lyllith… <pause>P-please let me use your cloak… <pause>I’m so c-c-c-cold…"
Lyllith knows damn well that this weather is nothing for him.
Not to mention her cloak would be like a napkin to a dragon.
Regardless, she humors him and gives him the cloak.
This took him off guard, he thought for sure she souldn’t go through with it.
But she did, and now he had to figure out how to tie this tiny thing around his neck.
And despite it being a joke at first…
It’s the little gestures that really get to him.
[pic=4]Aw! It’s the little genuine connections that do it!
They’ve been here for a while.
[pic=2]Heh, yeah we wanted to see what you guys were up to!
[pic=2]Yeah sorry! I didn’t mean to interrupt! I just got lost in the cuteness…
[pic=3]Oh, it’s just a scene and some characters from a book!
[pic=3]Rascal asked if I had any favorite books, and I was telling him about this one.
[pic=4]Yeah! Haha, I wasn’t expecting an audience heh!
[pic=2]How about… <pause>I turn up the heat and tell ya guys about one of the scenes between the two?
[pic=6]Blimey, between a Dragon and a Wolf?
[pic=3]Now close your eyes and imagine for a second…
Let’s see… Ah! Here we are…
Lyllith let out a gasp. Her body was trembling. Every part of her was on fire, she wanted MORE.
Volkyn’s fingers slipped further inside her. He was gentle, but his strength and size was apparent.
As his fingers explored her, he gently nipped and licked at her neck.
"Nnf ahh~!" Lyllith moaned. She’d taken on many dragons before… But not like this…
Volkyn’s muzzle met hers. Lyllith’s mouth was ajar, panting. He took that as an invitation.
They locked their lips together, passionately kissing and exploring eachother.
The wolf was overwelmed with the beast. Between making out and pleasured moans, she was gasping for breath.
Lyllith wrapped her legs around Volkyn’s arm. Bringing him closer, demanding him. Her hips lightly thrusting.
She shuddered in waves of pleasure, as she squeezed his fingers tightly.
Volkyn lifted his claw, her juices running down his arm. "Huh… Quite a mess…"
"Shut up, I’ll clean it." But he had begun lapping at his claws.
"Mmm…" A glimmer in his eyes flashed. "You know I’m a vegetarian… But I’d really like to taste you…"
"Straight from the tap, huh? Alright, go to town."
The dragon licked his lips and began making his way down her chest.
His breath was warm. His nostrils flared as he was taking in her every scent.
His muzzle pushed up against her vulva. The warmth against such a sensitive spot made her flinch.
He lapped at her a couple times, played with her lips with his, and finally, plunged his tongue inside.
Her legs tensed up. Her hips raised. She let out a gasp as his tongue went deeper and deeper.
The heat was incredible, and he explored every inch of her on his way.
He wrapped his claws around her legs to bring her even closer. But his tongue had no where else to go.
The dragon glanced up to see the wolf in bliss. Her back was arched, her tongue was flopping out.
He jostled his tongue around, and her hips bucked in response.
The familiar thrusting started as she let out a moan.
The dragon’s tongue slipped in and out. Fluids ran down his jaw and neck.
The wolf hadn’t been with a partner that truly satisfied her for a long time.
By the time they were done, it was late, and they collapsed into a warm, panting heap.
And though the sex was fantastic, Volkyn wanted nothing more than to stay in this moment…
